+- 01M5F234JM2BZEQ1TDMJK3FC4G

+position_ordinal: '8180'
+title: 'KANBAN-5: KanbanGraph conforms to GraphQLEndpoint and KanbanTool to GraphQLEndpointTool'
+---
+## What
+KANBAN-5 (TestudoApp/features/packages/foundationmodels-kanban.md) under EXTRAS-9 rules 1, 3, 4 (D115).
+
+- `KanbanGraph` (Sources/FoundationModelsKanban/Tool/KanbanGraph.swift) conforms to Extras `GraphQLEndpoint`: `name` = `"kanban"`, `version` = `"1"`, `scope` = `.sessionFolder`, `schema` = the printed SDL. `execute(query:variables:operationName:viewer:)` and `subscribe(...viewer:)` wrap the existing engine calls and give JSON text.
+- `KanbanTool` (Tool/KanbanTool.swift) conforms to `GraphQLEndpointTool`; `graphQLEndpoints` = `[graph]`, the same instance and serial gate the tool uses. The tool keeps one-document input and answers through `GraphQLTool.answer`, calling the graph with `viewer: nil`.
+- Viewer (EXTRAS-5, rule 4): `nil` and `.userDevice` see and edit all. `.external` edits only boards of its own sessions' folders. The host checks the endpoint folder itself (ACPA-13), but kanban also reaches other boards by `board:` (path, key, URI), `boards`, `moveTask(board:)`, `copyTask`, `collectBoards`, cross-board undo. For an `.external` viewer, any board other than this endpoint's folder board is refused (read and write) unless the host gives a way to map the viewer's sessions to folders. Open question sent to foundationmodelsmultitool-bc: GraphQLViewer carries session ids, not folders.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `KanbanGraph: GraphQLEndpoint` with name `kanban`, version `"1"`, scope `.sessionFolder`
+- [ ] `KanbanTool: GraphQLEndpointTool`, `graphQLEndpoints` returns the tool's own graph (identity, not a copy)
+- [ ] An `.external` viewer cannot read or write a board outside its allowed folders by any board ref form; refused with a coded error that does not reveal whether the board exists
+- [ ] `nil` and `.userDevice` viewers behave as today
+- [ ] No ACP dependency added
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Tool gives endpoint test: name, version, scope (EXTRAS-9 rule 11)
+- [ ] Viewer tests: external viewer on own board OK; on a sibling board via path, key, URI, `boards`, `moveTask(board:)`, `collectBoards` refused
+- [ ] execute/subscribe through the protocol give the same JSON as the direct calls
\ No newline at end of file
